title: History editorial treatment
changes: The History page now uses the Wave 7 editorial canvas with a restrained gold intro rule.
Heritage-collection context and search/filter controls use semantic paper/accent surfaces and shared focus treatment.
The timeline line, event markers and event cards form one coherent chronology rather than isolated database cards.
Evidence notes, interpretations, media cards, relationship chips and source disclosures have distinct but related treatments.
Reference and place/barangay relationship chips now meet the 44px interaction baseline.
Wide desktop spacing improves without changing the mobile chronology or filtering model.
preserved: All historical event text and dates
Evidence status labels and evidence notes
Primary/secondary source metadata and citation notes
Media captions, rights and source links
Person, institution, barangay, place and related-event relationships
Search, era/topic/order filters, primary-source-only filter and JSON download
